units.source_text: 中宫即皇后，职是官署的意思。

en.t: The Middle Palace refers to the empress, and the word Office means a government bureau.

units.source_text: 权表示额外增封或暂封。

en.t: Provisional indicates an additional appointment beyond the regular post, or a temporary appointment.
The Assistant Director is the deputy official of the Office.
